meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把一段文字(文章、笔记、主题等)变成一部「无脸讲解视频」:不拍摄真实画面,而是为每幕设计文字排版、图表等视觉,并生成故事板、旁白,最后输出 MP4 视频。
howto.when: 当你给出一段文字(文章、笔记、主题等)并要把它做成讲解视频,且没有可拍摄的网站或产品画面时触发;典型用途包括主题讲解、概念拆解、教程等。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成一个无脸讲解视频。
say.note: Claude 会读取文章并开始规划视频。

say.text: 把我这些关于光合作用的笔记做成视频,不要拍摄画面。
say.note: 会为每幕设计图表和排版来讲解。

say.text: 把这段泡手冲咖啡的步骤说明做成 60 秒教程视频。
say.note: 会生成脚本、分镜并渲染成短片。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude turns text (article, notes, topic) into a faceless explainer video: no real footage; visuals are invented per scene (typography, diagrams, charts). It produces a storyboard, narration, and a final MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you give a piece of text (article, notes, topic) and ask for an explainer video, with no website/product to film. Typical uses: topic explainers, concept breakdowns, tutorials, etc.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude reads the article and starts planning the video.

say_en.text: Make a video from my notes on photosynthesis, no real footage.
say_en.note: It designs diagrams and typography for each scene.

say_en.text: Turn these pour-over coffee steps into a 60-second tutorial video.
say_en.note: It will write a script, storyboard, and render a short clip.
